english.meaning: quite small; rather small in size
english.note: Reduplicated form, as in 細細條 for a smallish fish.

exampleSentences.english: Just put some water in to keep your fish. The fish were mostly tiny back then.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉𠻺噉𠻺攞啲水裝住你哩條魚囖。嗰陣時啲魚多數都係細細條𡃉啫。
